ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #15
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 40 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 41
   C. 43
   D. 31

2. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 10
   C. 26
   D. 5

3. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 144
   B. 48
   C. 24
   D. 156

4. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 90
   C. 81
   D. 18

5. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 1
   C. 13
   D. 7

6. Solve for x: x + 9 = 21. (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 13
   C. 9
   D. 12

7. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 42
   B. 12
   C. 36
   D. 24

8. In the number 3141, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 40
   C. 10
   D. 400

9. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 122
   C. 22
   D. 121

10. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 32
   C. 4
   D. 33

11. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 32
   B. 4
   C. 33
   D. 12

12. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 170
   B. 13
   C. 169
   D. 26

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

MARKING SCHEME

1. B — 41
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: c² = a² + b²
2. Substitute values: c² = 9² + 40²
3. c² = 81 + 1600
4. c² = 1681
5. c = 41
Final Answer: 41 cm
Mark reminder: method mark for Pythagoras; accuracy mark for hypotenuse
